description: While some Democrats build resumes in courtrooms or conference rooms, David has governed where it’s hardest: in communities squeezed by broken budgets, strained services, and underinvestment from the halls of power. His record is a blueprint for how Democrats must lead: with an urgent focus on real outcomes that rebuild public trust and make all of our lives better.
